newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - June 23.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - June 23.

text.p: -- Union Pacific Resources Group Inc said it has renewed its attempts to acquire Pennzoil Co after its previous advances were rebuffed. Now it is offering a two-step cash and stock transaction valued at about $6.4 billion. Union Pacific Resources closed at 26-3/8 Friday while Pennzoil closed at 59-5/8.

-- Dime Bancorp Inc said it has a definitive agreement to acquire North American Mortgage Co in an all-stock deal valued at about $374 million. Dime closed at 19 while North American closed at 23-1/8.

-- CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp now project their acquisition of Conrail Inc will provide them with more than $800 million a year in savings and operating income gains, the Wall Street Journal reported. The forecasts are 25 percent above previous estimates, the newspaper said. CSX finished at 54 while Norfolk Southern closed at 101.

-- State attorneys general who hammered out a landmark $368.5 billion settlement with the tobacco industry now turn to the question of how the money should be divided up. Philip Morris Cos Inc closed on the New York Stock Exchange at 45-5/8 and RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp finished at 34-1/2. In London Philip Morris was off 7/8 at 44-3/4 while RJR was down 1/2 at 34 there.
